Amount.description: A sum of money or a rate, as a Number that the canonical JSON serialization reproduces as written, with at most 15 significant digits inside the range of a double. It carries no currency; the entry it belongs to says which one it reads in.

developer_domain.description: Developer domain, informative; the governing developer domain comes from the store listing. No OpenRTB equivalent: not `app.domain`, which is the domain of the app

store.description: The app store that issued `bundle`. Core terms: `apple_app_store` | `google_play` | `roku_channel_store` | `amazon_appstore` | `samsung_apps_tv`. A `bundle` is unique only within its store. No OpenRTB equivalent

The app store that issued `bundle`. Core terms: `apple_app_store` | `google_play` | `roku_channel_store` | `amazon_appstore` | `samsung_apps_tv`. A `bundle` is unique only within its store. No OpenRTB equivalent

ClockWindow.description: A repeating window of civil time, on the days `days[]` names, from the first minute `start` up to `before`, the first minute after it, read on the line item's clock. It is deliberately not an interval between two points in time.

before.description: The first minute after the window.

days.description: The days the window repeats on.

ClockWindowNarrowing.description: Entries the buyer narrows to, `include[]`, less those it excludes, `exclude[]`. Exclusion wins.

exclude.description: The entries excluded from those included.

CurrencyCode.description: An ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code, such as `USD`.

DayName.description: A day of the week, named in lowercase English, from `monday` to `sunday`.

Delta.description: The price of one option outside `included[]`, as any of a change to the rate of a CPM or CPMV entry, a fraction that multiplies the rate of any entry, and a charge outside the rate. At least one is present.

delta_cpm.description: Added to the rate of a `CPM` or `CPMV` entry, and to no other.

delta_flat.description: A charge on any entry, outside the rate.

delta_fraction.description: Multiplies the rate of any entry by 1 plus this value.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 hash, written with its algorithm as `sha256:` and the 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the hash, 71 characters in all. The field that holds it says what its input is.

digest.description: Over the exact bytes served, with no content coding

url.description: The document. It MAY need authentication

Domain.description: A domain name in lowercase ASCII, its internationalized labels in A-label form, with no scheme, port, path, or trailing dot, such as `examplepub.example`. Two values are compared byte for byte.

Duration.description: A length of time, written in the ISO 8601 grammar of RFC 3339 Appendix A without its week form, such as `P14D` or `PT48H`, never `P2W`.

EntryRef.description: A named entry at one exact version, written `<domain>/<collection>/<entry_id>@<version>`, with no `/` or `@` inside a part, such as `examplepub.example/formats/homepage-takeover@3`. Its content doesn't change.

code.description: A core code (below) or an extension code

detail.description: Human-readable. A receiver SHOULD NOT parse it

pointer.description: Into the object this specification defines that the request carries, to the value that caused the error

retry.description: `same` | `refetch` | `none`. `same`: the same request can succeed later. `refetch`: a new attempt, composed on the current `version`, can succeed. `none`: only a changed request can succeed. On a `commit`, `same` keeps the `idempotency_key` and such an error is not a stored result (§ 5.6.1), and `refetch` and `none` take a new `idempotency_key`

version.description: The proposal's `version` when the error was decided

FieldPointer.description: A location in an object of the specification, written as a JSON Pointer, such as `/line_items/0/pricing/1/list_rate`.

FormatId.description: The ID of a creative format, written `<channel>/<name>`, where `<channel>` is the line item's channel, with no `/` or `@` inside a part, such as `display/300x250`.

Fraction.description: A proportion from 0 to 1, such as 0.7 for 70 %.

FractionDelta.description: A change to a rate as a fraction of it, a Number greater than -1, such as `0.20` for 20 percent more.

GeoCode.description: An area, written as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as `US`, an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, such as `US-CA`, or an extension term for any other area, such as a metro list. A country covers every subdivision code it prefixes.

GeoCodeNarrowing.description: Entries the buyer narrows to, `include[]`, less those it excludes, `exclude[]`. Exclusion wins.

exclude.description: The entries excluded from those included.

HttpsUrl.description: An absolute `https` URL, a location fetched over TLS.

IanaZone.description: A time zone, named as the IANA time zone database names it, such as `America/New_York` or `UTC`.

Instant.description: A point in time, written as an RFC 3339 date-time in whole seconds that ends in `Z`, such as `2026-11-02T00:00:00Z`, so one instant has one written form.

IntegerFlag.description: A yes or no written as an integer, `0` for no and `1` for yes, as AdCOM 1.0 and OpenRTB 2.6 write their flags, such as a placement's `instl`. A receiver reads it as a flag, never as a count, and a field that takes it keeps the integer its text writes.

NamespacedTerm.description: A term outside a vocabulary's core list, written `<domain>:<term>`, where the domain is one its definer controls and a term is ASCII letters, digits, `_`, and `-`, such as `examplepub.example:podcast-host-read`.

OpenObject.description: An object whose keys another definition sets, such as an owner's extension or an object another standard defines, which the field that holds it names.

legal_name.description: The party's legal name. A `registry_id` entry that applies can attest it; the value alone attests nothing

registry_id.description: An IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry reference for the entity controlling `domain`

PlainInteger.description: A whole number the text types as Integer and gives no other range, within the integers every JSON implementation reads exactly, from −(2^53 − 1) to 2^53 − 1; the field that holds it says what it counts.

PlainIntegerNarrowing.description: Entries the buyer narrows to, `include[]`, less those it excludes, `exclude[]`. Exclusion wins.

exclude.description: The entries excluded from those included.

PlainNumber.description: A number the text types as Number and gives no other range; the field that holds it says what it measures.

PlainString.description: A string the text types as String and gives no other form; the field that holds it says what it means.

RegistrableDomain.description: A domain that is the registrable domain of the Public Suffix List, taken over the whole list, its PRIVATE section included, written as a domain is, such as `examplepub.example`. It names a business.

ids.description: The ids the DSP issues, the same values OpenRTB 2.6 carries in `Deal.wseat`

taxonomy.description: A value from the list the field names

TimeOfDay.description: A civil time of day, written `HH:MM` from `00:00` to `24:00`, read on the line item's clock. `24:00` is the end of the day, so it ends a window and never starts one.

TimeZone.description: The clock a line item's daypart and frequency cap period are read on, a zone name of the IANA time zone database, such as `America/New_York` or `UTC`, or `viewer_local`, the clock where the ad renders. A zone name follows the zone's daylight saving rules, which a fixed offset doesn't.

Url.description: An absolute `http` or `https` URL, as RFC 3986 writes one, that a client can fetch.

line_item_id.description: A line item in that version
